headline: IEA report: AI data centers to strain power and raise emissions by 2030
summary: The International Energy Agency warned that AI-driven data-centre growth is straining power supply. One outlet reports datacentre carbon emissions will rise 70% within four years as the US and China lean on fossil fuels; another reports data-centre power demand will double by 2030 on the back of $4 trillion in spending, with power production barely keeping pace.
